//// About the Japanese novel and anime adaptations ////
Originally serialized in the bimonthly magazine Shosetsu June (小説ジュネ) spanning six chapters from December 1986 to October 1987, the novel was released with minor revisions into a hardcover edition in 1990.
This first version of the story received a two-episode/OVA anime adaptation in 1992 and 1994.
Between the years 2001 and 2007, the original story was greatly expanded upon and released in six paperback volumes. After a change of Japanese publisher, two more volumes were released between 2009 and 2010, completing the series (the six aforementioned volumes were released as volumes 1-4 in the newest Japanese edition).
This second version of the story was meant to be adapted into a twelve-episode OVA anime—initially planned to release in 2010—but was postponed to 2012, only to be discontinued after the fourth episode’s release.
//// About the English translation ////
The English paperback expanded edition is made up of eight volumes: the six first volumes (Seibido/Crystal edition) + the two later volumes (#7 and #8 in English, but #5 and #6 in the newest Tokuma/Chara edition).
The change in Japanese publisher led to a change in translator for the English edition between vol1 to 6 and vol7 to 8: it is highly recommended to read the fan translations of #7 and #8 as opposed to reading the licensed edition, due to the massive loss in translation (expect a 50% word count difference between the two).
//// Current translation status of the different editions of the novel (as of April 20th, 2024) //// 
. Shosetsu June edition, unlicensed: 2/6 chapters, ongoing fan translation.
. 1990 hardcover edition, unlicensed: 2/6 chapters, ongoing fan translation. An older fan translation had 4/6 chapters translated but the project was dropped.
. 2000’s expanded edition, English licensed: fully translated, complete.
//// Drama CDs, prequel and side stories ////
– The Shosetsu June story was adapted into a drama cassette and a drama CD (Dark Erogenous).
– The expanded story was adapted into three drama CDs (Destiny, Nightmare, Resonance)
– A prequel called Midnight Illusion was serialized in Shosetsu June between December 1992 and April 1993, and released as a hardcover in 1996. 3/6 chapters have been fan-translated into English.
– The 5 side stories have all been fan-translated into English (Kizu/Wound, File-0, Cal’s Sighs, Musk, Illusion Night) and are based on the expanded version of the novel.
Look up online “Ai no Kusabi Master List LiveJournal” to find the links to all the material listed above and more.

As the male lead’s childhood friend, she plays a role in their romance, which includes but is not limited to: giving up her inheritance for the male lead, rejecting the pursuit of an excellent male counterpart, running away from home to enter the entertainment industry starting from the bottom in variety shows, and constantly making things difficult for the female lead…
Currently, the plot has developed to the point where the original character is about to confess to the male lead at a banquet, only to be rejected and become a laughing stock in the circle.
Having read the original novel, Zhu Xinyue thought: completing this scene would make the male lead feel guilty and spend millions on her!
Opening her eyes, Zhu Xinyue’s vision was blurry.
Years of hard study plus a career as a corporate s*ave = severe myopia

Squinting, Zhu Xinyue scanned the room and spotted the tallest, best-built, most upright man in a suit.
The male lead in a romance novel must be the most handsome one. — Zhu Xinyue’s perfect plan
Zhu Xinyue grabbed the suited man’s hand, her eyes red from dryness, crying as she confessed, “I’ve liked you since the first moment I saw you. You’re so special, just standing there, you look like you’re about to break. I want to give you a home…”
Before she could finish, a man walked out from the pool, and the crowd teased, “Ji Qingyuan, your childhood sweetheart is going to run away with your brother!”
Ji Qingyuan is the male lead. His half-brother appears to be his strong backing but is actually a hidden schemer. Some readers even analyzed in long reviews that the brother is the biggest villain in the book.

The most handsome man in the room, Ji Linyu, said, “Miss Zhu, is it not a bit too soon to discuss marriage on our first meeting?”

In her previous life, she was born for medicine, and in this life, she was a genius in the field. It turned out—— it was because she hadn’t mastered her skills. She endured it, knowing that one day, all tricks would be like floating clouds in her eyes! The man had not only faked his death to deceive her but had also left himself half-dead. She, who had always been easygoing, completely exploded and ominously said: “Tell me, how do you want to die?”
Thus, the life of a certain person surnamed Wei became a living hell. It was truly difficult to coax his angered wife! Moreover, her divine medical skills attracted countless powerful backers. Not only did they obstruct his path to winning back his wife, but there were also people who wanted to snatch her away. It was intolerable! Later, the famous Wei Daren, whose name shook the court and was passed down through the ages, confronted heaven and earth outside, but at home, he was still a coward! ——Wei Tingyu, hmph, no matter how high his position, how powerful he was, or how much he enjoyed the emperor’s favor, fearing his wife was a man’s shame! ——Wei Tingyu, peerlessly handsome and doting on his wife without limits, was simply the most perfect husband. I want to marry him!
Translator’s Notes:
Wei Daren (魏大人): “Daren” is a respectful title for a high-ranking official in ancient China.

Raw sweet potatoes made her teeth ache, wild fruits left her mouth numb with their bitterness, and wild vegetable soup tasted as harsh as herbal medicine.

One more day of staring at food she couldn’t eat, and Guan Yue happened to meet a newly arrived educated youth. With a casual move, he cooked up a pot of chicken and yam soup, instantly winning Guan Yue’s heart.

From that moment on, the grand mansions of the city could no longer compare to the boundless mountains and forests—or to the cunning yet charming girl in front of him.

To protect his sacred straight-man dignity, Shao Ye hides his secondary gender and slogs away in the dirtiest, most backbreaking jobs in a desolate Dust Zone.

Rumor has it, this man is a beast in more ways than one—a notorious predator who’s “accidentally” offed over a dozen prospective Omegas. So Shao Ye does the only rational thing: he bolts.

“Eat up, don’t worry. Your health is the most important. I will study hard and make a name for myself. I’ll make sure you have a good life in the future!”

135675.synopsis:
Shen Yuan transmigrated into a world where everyone is involved in horror tales. Right from the start, he was thrown into hell-level difficulty—forced to share a coffin with a stunning female ghost!
But Shen Yuan wasn’t afraid.
Because he awakened the Death Card Draw System—as long as a ghost kills him, he can draw cards and grow stronger!
The first time he was killed—
【Ding! Card Draw Successful! Gained SSR-Level Experience Card, Instantly Leveled Up by 5!】
The second time—
【Ding! Received: Ghost Bride’s Wedding Dress ×1, Embroidered Shoes ×1… and a still-warm, freshly removed intimate bellyband!】
Holding the bellyband, its ghostly fragrance lingering in the air, Shen Yuan fell into deep thought:
Wait a minute… isn’t this a top-tier piece of gear?
Is this system’s loot drop… always this wild?!
Even more surprising was the ghost herself—deadly beautiful and bathed in blood.
“Wait, why does this ghost… look better every time I see her?”
“I was just here to farm gear, but… did I just farm myself a wife?”
—
Tang Li is a female ghost—ruler of slaughter, cold and merciless.
But this time, she met a man she couldn’t kill.
Kill him once—he levels up by five.
Kill him again—and her own clothes start dropping!
Tang Li panicked.
She didn’t want to kill him anymore. She wanted to run. She even tried to help him clear the level!
But that man… actually started killing himself in front of her, over and over again!
In the end, the once-feared Red-Dressed Ghost shrank into a corner of the coffin, eyes brimming with tears:
“Please… stop dying… I’m begging you, please don’t die again…”
—
【Rules are meant to be broken. Dungeons are for farming affection!】
【Wait a sec, wasn’t this supposed to be a horror infinite flow? How come the more I die, the more OP I become?!】
associated_names: 夜宿孤棺，高冷女鬼崩溃求我别死

136955.synopsis:

However, as Rishard grew into a beautiful young man, he was forced by the king of Northernheel to surrender his body. Though Arthur and Rishard knew they could never truly be united, neither could suppress the feelings pulling them toward one another. Yet Richard, having tasted despair, and Arthur, striving to grow into a ruler who would rightly lead his nation—their fates begin to diverge, until at last the time for rebellion arrives.

142331.synopsis:
“Wow, babe! I’ve missed you, you know?”
God of Water Veil—an MMORPG played by one out of every five Koreans. Before I suddenly quit the game for personal reasons, there was always one guildmate I couldn’t seem to stop getting tangled up with.
[(Necromancer) Kisekki: lol, what’s with those hands? Did your fingers break or something?] 
[(Dragon Knight) Yewoo Beomjeol: I’m sorry. I’ll try harder next time.] 
Worst first impression, worst compatibility. He did everything he could to kick me out. However…
“Wanna get married? I can really take good care of you.”
“You crazy bastard…! Shut up. Die. Just die.”
If we became close, maybe I wouldn’t have to leave the guild, right? Thanks to my stubborn persistence, I somehow managed to stay.
But in the end, we fought, and I quit the game. Then, when I came back—
“So my babe’s cozying up with another guy now?”
Why is actor Ki Se-hwa standing right in front of me? And they said his nickname was the Angel…
‘Did they mean demon instead?’
How could eyes that deranged belong to an angel?

169467.synopsis:
Yun Qingqing transmigrated into an old-fashioned novel.
The original host was the sidekick of the book’s vicious female supporting character, Gu Mingyan. She worked hard carrying bags and running errands, and from time to time was mocked and ridiculed by the other party.
Yun Qingqing was angry.
Other people transmigrated into books and stirred up storms, rising to the peak of life.
She transmigrated into a book only to be ordered around — just changing places to continue being treated like an ox or horse?
Counterattack! She wanted to counterattack!!
…
Just when Yun Qingqing rolled up her sleeves and prepared to make a big move, she discovered that this vicious female supporting character’s ridicule was somewhat different.
When attending a banquet, Gu Mingyan disliked that her clothes were too ugly and loudly bought a pile of luxury brands to send to her home.
Gu Mingyan frowned tightly.
“Stop wearing those rags, or people will say my friend is shabby.”
At a yacht party at sea, the once-poor Yun Qingqing looked around in novelty. The next day, the yacht was transferred under her name.
Gu Mingyan curled her lips.
“What’s so interesting about a broken yacht? If you like it, I’ll give it to you.”
When attending a concert, after learning that Yun Qingqing couldn’t get tickets, Gu Mingyan turned around and acquired the entertainment agency.
Gu Mingyan was puzzled.
“You need to fight for tickets just to listen to songs? I’ll just open a private session for you.”
Yun Qingqing: ?? This kind of ridicule, can I have more?
….
In order to maintain this firm revolutionary friendship, Yun Qingqing protected Gu Mingyan closely.
She punched s*umbags and kicked gossipers, blocking all rumors and slander.
At the same time, she set her sights on the culprit who would cause the Gu family’s bankruptcy in the future — the darkened illegitimate son.
Ideological education is crucial!
Today she stuffed him a coffee cup printed with the Criminal Law Code.
Tomorrow she looped recitations of the Tao Te Ching in his ear.
Until one stormy night, the young man trapped her in his arms, his breath scorching hot:
“You’ve taught morality for 365 days—”
“So now, do you want to do something… immoral?”

195579.synopsis:
Qiū Lín transmigrates into the wildly popular superpowered fantasy manga《Uncharted》.
He’s one of the comic’s most infamous haters.
His combat power in online arguments is terrifying—his critique essays are packed with references and citations, and when debating fans, he can recite obscure plot details from memory.
Good news: He can probably predict future events and avoid every dangerous storyline before it happens.
Bad news: He accidentally transmigrates into a nameless, extremely unpopular cannon-fodder extra who appears for less than half an episode before dying.
…An old man.
Bad news ×2: This is a high-risk superpowered world. Fireballs are thrown by hand, street-destroying brawls are a daily occurrence, and whether mu*der or arson is illegal often seems open to interpretation.
Meanwhile, his own combat power is roughly 0.5 geese, and even a light jog leaves him gasping for breath and worried he’ll throw out his back.
Old Man · Frail · Qiū Lín blacks out.
Fortunately, one month after transmigrating, his golden finger finally arrives:
A forum connected directly to the audience.
As long as he successfully appears in No Crossing, earns discussion and popularity from readers, and avoids placing in the bottom three of the forum’s popularity polls, he’ll be able to extend his lifespan.
Qiū Lín looks down at his body and attempts a salted-fish flip…
He fails.
He almost throws out his back again.
So he lies flat once more.
—He’s already at retirement age. Hot-blooded adventures and flashy heroics are for the young. Following the original script and quietly enjoying his retirement doesn’t sound too bad!
…Just kidding.
If he can struggle, he’ll struggle.
While leisurely slacking off, Qiū Lín pokes a fallen enemy with a knife, drags the protagonist back from danger for reasons he doesn’t fully understand, and suddenly realizes:
…Maybe this situation isn’t beyond saving after all?
Who says old men can’t fight?
Old men can be cool too!
As for somehow turning from an “old man” into a handsome young guy through literal rejuvenation…
Qiū Lín lets out an innocent whistle.
“Come on. Wasn’t everyone a handsome young man once?”
associated_names: 年老系也能成为人气角色吗

212475.synopsis:
As the son of a famous congressman, Seo Rihyeon grew up wanting for nothing. He achieves his dream of marrying Yoon Jaeseung, whom he fell in love with at first sight as a child, but the sweet fantasy shatters in an instant.
The only time Jaeseung seeks out Rihyeon is to resolve his ruts and desires.
Just as Rihyeon, withering away from his family’s downfall and Jaeseung’s cold indifference, decides on a divorce…
…he meets his end in a sudden car accident.
And when he opens his eyes, he has returned to three years in the past, two months before his wedding.
Determined not to repeat his miserable past, he desperately tries to avoid marrying Jaeseung in this life, but…
“…Managing Director, I… I’m thinking of divorce. All this time… I think it was just admiration….”
“Is marriage a joke to you? Why don’t we get married, and then get divorced?”
Why could it be?
Why is Jaeseung looking at him with different eyes than before?
“Think carefully about who you married.”
